description: Adversarially test agents with broken APIs, latency spikes, revoked permissions, prompt injections, and malformed payloads.
notes: Shared kit landed mid-build; re-targeted to the real shared/kit.js contract.

notes.note: Chaos engineering for the agent stack is a product for a market that doesn't exist yet: most teams don't have reliable agents, let alone budget to break them on purpose. This is selling load-testing in 1998. The timing assumption is fatal — come back in three years when agent fleets are boring and stable.
Chaos run auto-starts; live log streams scenarios; re-run works; zero errors.

notes.change: Per-scenario run buttons plus copyable markdown bug reports on failures.
Removed empty 4th placeholder KPI card; KPI grid now auto-fits 3 or 4 cards.
